Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://ludhiana.dcourts.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Ludhiana District Courts to hire eligible candidates for various positions in the district judiciary system.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Lift Operator under Employment Notice No.3 of 2026 released by Ludhiana District Courts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Lift Operator position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through offline mode by downloading the form and sending it via post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline application forms is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need Matriculation with Punjabi as a subject and an ITI Trade certificate in Mechanical or Electrical from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 37 years as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Lift Operator post will be strictly based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form from the official website at https://ludhiana.dcourts.gov.in.
